brief:
Ansarullah's spokesman marked the first anniversary of commander Abu Ubaidah's death by pledging that his legacy will continue to trouble the Israeli occupation until its collapse, Shehab Wire reported. The Yemeni group framed the Palestinian cause as central to Abu Ubaidah's sacrifice and that of other fallen leaders in the movement.

The spokesman said the Palestinian question will remain the primary voice and central issue across all fronts of resistance. Abu Ubaidah, a senior commander in the Iran-aligned group, died in the past year as the organization intensified operations linked to events in Gaza. Ansarullah has positioned itself as a key actor in regional conflicts tied to Palestinian affairs.
